STA Scheduled Tasks - Reference

Every recurring STA / AI-system automation, what it does, and when it runs  ·  Adam Baker  ·  Updated 2026-08-17

INTERNAL · ADMIN REFERENCE

What this is: the catalog of scheduled tasks that keep STA's work products and AI system running - daily, weekly, and monthly jobs that fire on their own in Cowork.

Scope: STA work automations and AI-system maintenance only. Adam's personal jobs (personal email, house/listing scans, local events, civic-campaign posts, personal-brain captures) are intentionally excluded - this is the work-and-system list.

Status pills: Enabled runs on schedule; Disabled exists but is paused.

Weekly

TaskWhenWhat it doesStatus
System Monitor health checkMon 8:00 AMAutomated health check of the whole School Tech AI ecosystem; posts a structured report to Slack. Includes truncation checking as Check 15 (System Monitor v1.23), which is read-only - it reports clipped files and never repairs them. There is no --fix-nulls pass and nothing auto-fixes a truncated file; every repair is a deliberate follow-up.Enabled
R&D time trackingMon 8:00 AMPulls the prior week's 3 product-dev meetings, updates per-meeting Word notes + the Excel R&D credit tracker (with Stage column).Enabled
Knowledge base update checkerMon 9:09 AMReports overdue KB topics in chat + to #kb-update-check; folds in the semi-annual health-insurance live-figure check when due.Enabled
Weekly review ingestionTue 4:00 PMReads Adam's submitted weekly-review form receipt straight from the adamb@k12sta.com Gmail connector (read-only), appends it to the Work Brain weekly-review archive under its submission date, drops a durable brain note when the review contains one, and pushes Projects-column status into the D1 project tracker. Dedupe-gated on submission date, so a manual re-run when the 1:1 moves can never double-append.Enabled

Monthly & periodic

TaskWhenWhat it doesStatus
Help Center report1st, 7:00 AMMonthly Salesforce Help Center analytics report from live GA4 data.Enabled
Site analytics report1st, 7:00 AMMonthly k12sta.com marketing-site analytics report, leadership-ready.Enabled
Context staleness check1st, 8:00 AMFlags Claude.ai Project context files unchanged 60+/90+ days.Enabled
Brain registry audit2nd, 9:00 AMAudits both brains against the agent registry - catches deprecated-but-active notes, renames, missing agents, duplicate titles; auto-fixes safe items.Enabled
Architect watchdogMonthlyThe Architect's monthly behavior self-audit (Part A) plus the Valence Gate compliance check (Part C). Samples recent Architect sessions against the documented trigger classes and hard rules, checks the artifact trail (version/changelog agreement, staged-diff promotion completeness, file-tail integrity), and audits that valenced claims about Adam carry their required receipts. Confirmed violations are routed to The Architect's backlog; a clean month is reported as clean rather than padded. Report lands in Claude/reports/architect-watchdog/YYYY/MM/. Dedupe-gated to one run per calendar month.Enabled
Architect second opinionQuarterly - 1st of Jan / Apr / Jul / OctAssembles The Architect's quarterly adversarial review package (Part B): current instructions version and measured word count against its own compaction trigger, the newest evaluation and how many versions stale it is, the last three watchdog reports, the last ten changelog rows, and a paste-ready review prompt. Adam runs that prompt in a fresh chat with no Architect instructions loaded, ideally on a different model. Findings come back as Advisory; nothing is self-applied unreviewed. Saved to Claude/reports/architect-second-opinion/YYYY/MM/.Enabled
Help Center scanLast Fri, 2:00 PMScans the STA help center for new articles, auto-categorizes into hc-data.json, rebuilds the Support Hub index + dist.Enabled
Skyward Friday digestLast Fri, 2:10 PMFull Skyward scan across 8 sources (public + login) since last run; produces a self-contained HTML digest.Enabled

How this list was built, and what came off it

This catalog is rebuilt against the live scheduled-task store - one row per task folder that actually exists - rather than edited by memory. The 2026-08-17 pass removed seven rows:

Removed rowWhy
Truncation daily scanRetired. Truncation checking now runs read-only as Check 15 of the Monday System Monitor health check.
Wren promotion to brainRetired - moved to the retired-task store.
Brain auto-tidyRetired and superseded. The row also described the wrong scope: tidying covers the Work Brain only, never "both brains."
Skill-backup safety netNo task folder in the live store - these four had no running task behind them. Removed on Adam's explicit approval, 2026-08-17, rather than being carried as unverifiable rows.
Meeting decisions to brain
Slack decisions to STA brain
Evening meeting recap

Four live tasks that had never been listed were added in the same pass: the two Architect self-audit jobs (monthly watchdog, quarterly second opinion), weekly review ingestion, and Adam's private daily work check-in.

Maintaining these tasksScheduled tasks are Cowork-only. When creating or editing one that touches project files, the folder field must be set to the workspace folder (...\STA Projects\The Architect) - an empty folder field launches the run with nothing mounted and it fails with "files inaccessible." Architect-produced recurring outputs are created and updated by The Architect; project-specific tasks are owned by their project's Cowork chat; system-wide jobs by System Monitor.
